mentions.name: Protoville
mentions.description: This event is a popup village in rural South Korea combining co-working, co-living and local activities such as trail running and bird watching. The next iteration plans a stronger co-working component with a more predictable schedule, where participants share their personal and professional intentions with each other so they can accomplish those intentions with help from other participants.
mentions.problem: Co-working organizing at the first event could have been better, lacking a predictable schedule participants could lock in.
mentions.source_excerpt: I helped co-host a popup village in rural South Korea last week. Mix of co-working, co-living and local activities like trail running and bird watching.
